diffs.diff: pin count: part has 3 (PWR GND SIG), datasheet reading has 4 (Pin 1 Power (brown) Pin 2 Ground (black) Pin 3 Signal (blue) Pin 4 NC)
diffs.evidence: Adafruit product 1733 page: 'Connector details: Pin 1 - Power (brown wire), Pin 2 - Ground (black wire), Pin 3 - Signal (blue wire), Pin 4 not connected' and 'connect the black wire to power and signal ground, the brown wire to 7-24VDC ... and measure the analog voltage on the blue wire'. The 4th plug pin is not connected and has no wire in the cable, so the three wired signals (brown PWR, black GND, blue SIG) modelled by the part are the complete usable pinout; the part already notes plug pin 4 is NC. Same wording in the DigiKey copy of the product page (1733_Web.pdf).
